name: Pune Metro phase 2 (four new corridors)
title: Pune Metro phase 2: Kharadi-Khadakwasla, Ramwadi-Wagholi and two more corridors, status
summary: Maha Metro's second phase: about 44 km on four corridors costing about Rs 13,500 crore. Line 4 Kharadi to Khadakwasla (about 25.5 km), Line 4A Nal Stop to Manik Baug, Line 2A Vanaz to Chandani Chowk and Line 2B Ramwadi to Wagholi.
means: Phase 2 has a five-year target from November 2026: no train runs on it yet. Near Kharadi, Wagholi or Sinhagad Road, expect years of construction traffic before any station opens.

faq.q: Which corridors are in Pune Metro phase 2?
faq.a: Line 4 Kharadi to Khadakwasla, Line 4A Nal Stop to Manik Baug, Line 2A Vanaz to Chandani Chowk and Line 2B Ramwadi to Wagholi: about 44 km in all.
The target reported at the foundation stone on 3 November 2026 is five years. This page follows each tender and stretch.

faq.q: Will the Ramwadi-Wagholi metro be a double-decker?
faq.a: Maha Metro is likely to build the Ramwadi-Wagholi stretch as one double-decker structure, metro above a road flyover, with MSIDC paying for the road part (reported 16 November 2026).

history.status: The Prime Minister laid the foundation stone for phase 2: four corridors of about 44 km costing about Rs 13,500 crore, with a five-year target.
Foundation stone laid on 3 November. Maha Metro is likely to build the Ramwadi-Wagholi stretch itself as a double-decker, metro above a road flyover, with MSIDC paying for the road part.

Tenders have begun: Maha Metro invited bids for the 6.5 km SNDT-Warje stretch, with two flyovers planned at Karve Putala Chowk and Ambedkar Chowk. The Ramwadi-Wagholi stretch is likely to be built as a double-decker.
